summary_rationale: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS business-quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Unlike acquisition-dependent pharmaceutical peers, Regeneron operates a repeatable, founder-led internal discovery engine (VelociSuite) paired with wholly owned mammalian biologics manufacturing in Rensselaer and Limerick, generating 81% FY2025 product gross margins (79% in 9M 2026 after $176.1M temporary manufacturing interruption costs) and converting 90.6% of FY2025 GAAP net income ($4,504.9M) into Free Cash Flow ($4,080.5M) even after expensing $5,850.2M (40.8% of revenue) in R&D. Operationally, Q3 2026 marked a strong top-line inflection: total revenue grew 36% YoY to $5,115.8M, Dupixent reached $6.5B in quarterly global net sales (+35% YoY), Eylea HD grew 62% YoY to $699M (~64% of the $1,099M U.S. retinal franchise, which dipped 1% YoY as 2 mg Eylea fell 41% to $400M and HD saw lower net selling prices), Libtayo reached a $2.2B annualized run rate ($550M, +51% YoY), and June 30, 2026 full repayment of the Sanofi development balance drove Q3 Sanofi collaboration revenue up 68% YoY to $2,724M alongside the October 1, 2026 Sixth Amendment ($1.0B upfront, up to $7.0B milestones, and dismissal of the Dupixent audit-rights suit). With $16.15B in net cash (Q3 2026, net of $1,987.0M debt and $720.0M finance leases), Regeneron self-funds multi-modality pipeline expansion. Watch items remain 77% FY2025 gross product revenue concentration in two distributors, 2 mg Eylea biosimilar erosion (Pavblu post-Federal Circuit ruling and 2027 entrants), Bayer ex-U.S. Eylea softness (-23% YoY), Eylea HD PFS/Rensselaer fill-finish FDA validation, 340B/IRA/tariff/Pillar Two headwinds, $1,577.9M uncertain tax reserves, and building a $10B+ commercial bridge ahead of Dupixent's ~2031 U.S. patent expiration.
